title: reactions
description: Named-reaction library (constant/reactions). Top-level keys are reaction names; units in flowsheetDict refer to them by name.

order.description: Reaction order in this component (defaults to 0 for products).

Kinetics.description: The rate law, selected by `type` through the ReactionRate factory (thermo/reaction/ReactionRate.H). Built in: `Arrhenius` and `LHHW` (power law / Langmuir-Hinshelwood-Hougen-Watson, A and Ea), `expression` (the law written here as a formula -- every number in the case, DEV.md 4c C67). batchReactor also reads its own CHEMKIN words (modifiedArrhenius, thirdBody, falloff). A case's code/ folder may register its own word (local only: the site has no compiler).

source.description: expression: the citation the numbers come from. Required.

basis.description: expression: per m3 of reactor (catalyst BED, for a packed bed) or per kg of catalyst (the reactor then needs catalystLoading). Required, no default.

rateOf.description: expression: `extent`, or a component whose net formation rate the formula is (divided by its nu). Required.

parameters.description: expression: named constants, each WITH its unit (`-` for a pure number).

tables.description: expression: 1-D tables -- `x ( ... ); xUnit u; <column> ( ... ); ...; yUnit u;` -- each column callable as a function of one argument, linear between its points, refused outside them.

definitions.description: expression: named formulas (quoted), evaluated in dependency order; a cycle is refused.

rate.description: expression: the rate formula, with the dimensions of its basis. Either this, or forward + reverse.

forward.description: expression: the forward leg; the net rate is forward - reverse and their balance is the law's own equilibrium.

rateConstant.description: expression: `{ name <parameter or definition>; unit <u>; }` -- what the reactor publishes as k_<reaction>.

fugacityCoefficients.description: expression: `<component> <definition>;` -- the law's OWN fugacity coefficients; the pfr publishes their ratio to the package's at the inlet.

validity.description: expression: `<symbol|parameter|definition> { min; max; outside announce|refuse; unit; }`.

equilibriumTemperatureWindow.description: expression with legs: `{ min .. K; max .. K; }` -- where the law's own equilibrium temperature is searched (the pfr's approach_K).

caveats.description: expression: sentences announced on every run.
